tasks.label: ui-build-status
tasks.command: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && echo 'BUILD_OK'

tasks.label: check-actions-runs
tasks.command:
curl -sS https://api.github.com/repos/A5-CC/digital_product_ui/actions/runs?per_page=5 | python3 -c 'import sys, json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("total", d.get("total_count"));
for r in d.get("workflow_runs", [])[:5]: print(r.get("name"), r.get("status"), r.get("conclusion"), r.get("html_url"))'

tasks.label: check-actions-runs-2
tasks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
url='https://api.github.com/repos/A5-CC/digital_product_ui/actions/runs?per_page=5'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
    d=json.load(r)
print('total', d.get('total_count'))
for run in d.get('workflow_runs', [])[:5]:
    print(run.get('name'), run.get('status'), run.get('conclusion'), run.get('html_url'))
PY
